boxes.reason: Win7 on a GTX 1650 with the Standard VGA stub: no 3D driver, and SoF has only ref_gl (it would fall back to GDI generic software GL).
Not installed there: operator override 'not wanted on .243', and the P166 is below the 266 MHz floor.

summary: 0 of 10 boxes ready. 8 applicable boxes (.110 .123 .124 .133 .143 .171 .184 .240) render SoF fullscreen (1280x960, 1024x768 on .184, 1920x1080 on .240). The final re-check relaunched 7 of them and photographed each one. On every box SoF's CD-token check refused its own loopback client ('WON Error! Please insert the SOF CD and try again.'), so no level loads and no shared game is possible. .186 and .243 are NA. All SoF processes are closed.
issues: CDTOKEN needs <exe dir>\FFC11.DLL (from the retail disc's SETUP folder), which the staged tree lacks (only FFC10.dll is there), plus an MCI cdaudio drive with the retail 2-track layout
No SoF1 dedicated server exists on .132
lanparty.py kill takes the game as a positional argument; '--game' is rejected
The final pass relaunched 7 boxes; .124 was not relaunched (its evidence is from this round's single launch)
library_fix_needed: Stage FFC11.DLL from the retail image (Files/Games/Windows XP/Soldier of Fortune (2000).zip -> sof.bin/sof.cue, SETUP folder) beside SoF.exe in Games-Library/SoldierOfFortune
Stage the bin+cue (keeping audio track 2) under _disc with a make-mount-launcher spec, gated on disc_mount, or use an official CD-check-free SoF.exe
Then a SoF1 dedicated server on .132 (or a fleet box hosting) for a shared round
